diagnostics.title: Large component is hard to read and change
diagnostics.message: Component "PlaylistSection" is over 300 lines long, which is hard to read & change. Split it into a few smaller components.
diagnostics.help: Pull each section into its own component so the parent is easier to read, test, and change.

diagnostics.title: Many related useState calls
diagnostics.message: "PlaylistSection" updates 5 separate useState values in one place — state that changes together is easier to keep consistent as a single useReducer action.
diagnostics.help: Group state that always changes together into `useReducer` so one dispatched action describes the whole transition instead of a list of setter calls.

diagnostics.title: fetch Response consumed without status check
diagnostics.message: `fetch()` resolves (does not reject) on HTTP 4xx/5xx, so this unchecked body read may treat an HTTP error payload like a successful response. Check `response.ok`/`response.status`, or deliberately handle the API's error payload, before reading the body.
diagnostics.help: Check `response.ok` (or `response.status`) before consuming a `fetch` Response with `.json()`/`.text()`/`.blob()`. `fetch` resolves on HTTP 4xx/5xx, so an unchecked response parses the error body as success or crashes on an always-truthy guard.

diagnostics.title: Pure function rebuilt every render
diagnostics.message: `handleConnectSpotify` inside `PlaylistSection` uses no local state but is rebuilt on every render, so it wastes work & breaks memoized children. Move it to the top of the file, outside the component.
diagnostics.help: Move the function above the component, at the top of the file. It doesn't use local state, so rebuilding it each update is wasted work.

diagnostics.title: Chained array iterations
diagnostics.message: This loops over your list twice because .filter().map() makes two passes, so do it in one pass with .reduce() or a for...of loop
diagnostics.help: Combine `.map().filter()` style chains into one pass with `.reduce()` or a `for...of` loop, so you only loop over the list once

diagnostics.title: Plain img ships unoptimized images
diagnostics.message: Plain ships unoptimized, oversized images.
diagnostics.help: Use `next/image` so users get optimized formats, responsive srcsets, and lazy loading instead of oversized image downloads.

diagnostics.title: transition: all animates everything
diagnostics.message: Your users see janky animation because `transition-all` animates every property that changes, including expensive layout ones and instant ones like focus rings. Name the properties: `transition-colors`, `transition-opacity`, or `transition-transform`.
diagnostics.help: List the specific properties: `transition: "opacity 200ms, transform 200ms"`. In Tailwind, use `transition-colors`, `transition-opacity`, or `transition-transform`
